title: Chapter close — Climax: volume / mass duality
html:
This completes the q-hyperbolic geometric counterpart to The Mass Endomorphism: the categorical Möbius self-avoidance energy, the crossing-energy and Coulomb-asymmetry identities, the Lagrange resolvent kinematics on \Sigma_4, the knot-operator shadow-price ordering and per-component linking weights \mathrm{lw}(c), and the vertex-algebra spectral filter culminating in the annihilation of T_{2,11}.

The next two chapters combine the algebraic trace of The Mass Endomorphism with the hyperbolic geometry of this chapter: Mass Analysis derives the elementary-particle, gauge-boson, hadron, and nuclear mass formulas across the geometric and Archimedean faces, and Nuclear Interactions and Binding applies confluent Gröbner–Shirshov reduction and semidefinite operator selection to multi-nucleon binding energies and \beta-decay Q-values.
